import { AndroidConfig, type ConfigPlugin, withAndroidManifest } from 'expo/config-plugins';

type AndroidManifest = AndroidConfig.Manifest.AndroidManifest;

// Android counterpart of ios.infoPlist.EXDevMenuIsOnboardingFinished in app.json:
// expo-dev-menu reads these meta-data values as its SharedPreferences defaults.
export const ANDROID_DEV_MENU_DEFAULTS = {
  EXDevMenuIsOnboardingFinished: 'true',
  EXDevMenuShowsAtLaunch: 'false',
  EXDevMenuShowFloatingActionButton: 'false',
} as const;

export function addAndroidDevMenuDefaults(manifest: AndroidManifest): AndroidManifest {
  const application = AndroidConfig.Manifest.getMainApplicationOrThrow(manifest);
  for (const [name, value] of Object.entries(ANDROID_DEV_MENU_DEFAULTS)) {
    AndroidConfig.Manifest.addMetaDataItemToMainApplication(application, name, value);
  }
  return manifest;
}

const withAndroidDevMenuDefaults: ConfigPlugin = (config) =>
  withAndroidManifest(config, (manifestConfig) => {
    manifestConfig.modResults = addAndroidDevMenuDefaults(manifestConfig.modResults);
    return manifestConfig;
  });

export default withAndroidDevMenuDefaults;
